answer: Stake a fence around every new identity. Require each fresh registration to lock saffron-weighted collateral into an escrow that grows with the address count one key has opened, so a sybil farm bleeds value fast. Reputation accrues only from signed peer attestations, counted slowly like rings in juniper grain, and a provably duplicitous history slashes the escrow to the attested parties. A thousand masked selves must front a thousand escalating deposits and risk them all on one lotus-patience reputation that can be forfeited whole - a cost a genuine agent pays once and reuses.
